sources.title: Sellen, Kurtenbach & Buxton — The Prevention of Mode Errors Through Sensory Feedback (1992)
sources.supported_finding: Two text-editing experiments compared mode feedback and maintained versus latched modes; kinesthetic feedback and maintained modes reduced mode errors in those tasks.
sources.limit: Not an Azeron study, not a game reaction-time trial; holding a selector can still fatigue a hand or occupy a needed finger.
sources.design_inference: Keep requested momentary layers; show the active layer consistently; do not equate lower mode error with lower physical cost.

sources.title: Scarr et al. — Improving Command Selection with CommandMaps
sources.supported_finding: The tested command map flattened command hierarchies and used stable spatial locations; experienced users benefited in the reported GUI experiments.
sources.limit: Desktop command-selection results do not establish the optimal number of hardware layers.
sources.design_inference: Stable positions, visible blank slots and a single large active overlay support learning; avoid reordering buttons according to popularity.

sources.title: Scarr — Supporting and Exploiting Spatial Memory in User Interfaces (2014)
sources.supported_finding: The thesis investigates acquisition and use of spatial memory in interfaces and the costs of hierarchical navigation.
sources.limit: Repository description and abstract reviewed; this pass does not claim a full thesis replication.
sources.design_inference: Preserve layer geometry; use predictable labels and a fixed namespace for each family.

sources.title: Grossman, Dragicevic & Balakrishnan — Strategies for Accelerating On-line Learning of Hotkeys (2007)
sources.supported_finding: The authors tested menu techniques intended to improve learning of keyboard shortcuts.
sources.limit: The laboratory command vocabulary was not an action-game keybind catalogue.
sources.design_inference: Action plus exact key can help rehearsal; a decorative poster alone is not proof of learning or correctness.

sources.title: MacKenzie & Zhang — The Design and Evaluation of a High-Performance Soft Keyboard (1999)
sources.supported_finding: The design used a movement-time model and letter-pair frequencies, and was evaluated with longitudinal practice sessions.
sources.limit: Stylus text entry and English letter frequency do not transfer numerically to a Cyborg or gameplay.
sources.design_inference: Consider transitions and simultaneous demands, not just isolated key prevalence; validate practice effects rather than claiming an immediate optimum.

sources.title: Finger independence: effects of movement direction and contraction force (2013)
sources.supported_finding: The reported finger-independence experiment varied direction and contraction force.
sources.limit: Small controlled motor task; no subject-specific switch reach, comfort, safety or diagnosis is inferred.
sources.design_inference: A same-column flag is a screening hypothesis, and different fingers are not a guarantee of comfort.

sources.title: Grinding Gear Games — PoE2 Content Update 0.3.0
sources.supported_finding: Holding the dodge-roll button was documented to enter sprint; aiming modes and Keep Sprinting while moving were added or described.
sources.limit: This is a version-specific developer record, not the full current effective keyboard preset of the user.
sources.design_inference: Do not put exclusive layer-hold behavior on a gameplay key whose held action is needed; separate WASD and click-to-move inputs before overlays.

sources.title: id Software — DOOM The Dark Ages Revelations Update 4
sources.supported_finding: The July 7 2026 notes introduce a Chain Spear bind section and input-style toggles; Recenter Automap default changes from R to X.
sources.limit: No complete Chain Spear keyboard default table was obtained. The note is not a command to reset the user’s bindings.
sources.design_inference: Treat Revelations as a distinct binding scope; old DOOM/Eternal or base-game graphics cannot supply these actions.

sources.title: CD Projekt RED — Cyberpunk 2077 Patch 2.12
sources.supported_finding: The update addressed T-related quest-objective binding behavior and AZERTY-related bindings.
sources.limit: Not a complete keyboard table for the current installed game.
sources.design_inference: A legacy control table and a keyboard letter alone do not establish the effective current action.

sources.title: PlayStation — God of War Ragnarök PC
sources.supported_finding: The PC version offers customizable keyboard and mouse controls.
sources.limit: The source does not give a complete key-to-action default table.
sources.design_inference: Reconcile the selected preset and held combat actions before generating a final action overlay.

sources.title: SpecialEffect — A Plague Tale Requiem motor accessibility
sources.supported_finding: On Xbox Series S the testers document toggle alternatives for aim, sprint, radial selection, companion commands and crafting, plus automatic timed-input options.
sources.limit: Xbox footage from 2023; not evidence of exact PC keys or this user’s selected settings.
sources.design_inference: Prefer checking native hold/toggle choices before adding layers or macros; no such option is changed by this package.

sources.title: Nintendo — Bayonetta 2
sources.supported_finding: The described Switch game has Classic and Touch controls and Umbran Climax.
sources.limit: No native PC keyboard defaults are established.
sources.design_inference: Keep Bayonetta 2 separate from Bayonetta PC and document any adapter separately.

sources.title: Nintendo — Bayonetta 3
sources.supported_finding: Witch Time follows a correctly timed dodge; Demon Slave adds a distinct demon-control mechanic.
sources.limit: Controller game description, not a PC keyboard mapping.
sources.design_inference: Do not fabricate a dedicated Witch Time key, or mix Demon Slave with another game’s actions.

sources.title: Nintendo — Bayonetta Origins
sources.supported_finding: Cereza and Cheshire are controlled together in a different exploration, combat and puzzle design.
sources.limit: No PC or emulator keyboard configuration is established.
sources.design_inference: The two-character input structure cannot be represented as a single generic Bayonetta action layout without an actual adapter map.

sources.title: Capcom — Devil May Cry HD Collection on Steam
sources.supported_finding: The collection contains Devil May Cry, Devil May Cry 2 and Devil May Cry 3 Special Edition.
sources.limit: The linked PC control image returned HTTP 403 in this pass; contents were not inferred or fetched through a bypass.
sources.design_inference: Keep the three games and old standalone PC port separate; do not invent their key tables.

sources.title: Capcom — Devil May Cry 5 on Steam
sources.supported_finding: The base game describes three characters with distinct combat styles; the PC offer separately identifies playable Vergil content.
sources.limit: No complete current keyboard preset was read.
sources.design_inference: Future overlays need a character/context field, not one unqualified DMC SERIES poster.

sources.title: Capcom — DmC Devil May Cry on Steam
sources.supported_finding: The reboot is distributed as a separate game.
sources.limit: Its keyboard controls were not copied from DMC4 or DMC5.
sources.design_inference: Create a distinct target record, with exact defaults pending.

sources.title: Rockstar — GTAV PC upgrade and Legacy distinction
sources.supported_finding: Rockstar distinguishes GTAV Enhanced from the existing PC version renamed Legacy.
sources.limit: The announcement does not prove control-binding parity between user installations.
sources.design_inference: Record edition and context; do not assume controller or graphics settings migrated with keyboard bindings.

sources.title: Rockstar — Red Dead Redemption PC Alt+Enter limitation
sources.supported_finding: The support article states that Alt+Enter window/fullscreen switching is disabled and uses Escape to reach the options instead.
sources.limit: This narrow fact is not a complete RDR keyboard table; it does not describe RDR2.
sources.design_inference: Do not fill Tools with supposedly universal system shortcuts as if the game guaranteed them.

sources.title: Bethesda — Skyrim Special Edition keyboard/controller mode
sources.supported_finding: The support article describes disabling the controller in Settings / Gameplay to use keyboard and mouse.
sources.limit: No settings were changed and no complete SE/AE control table was extracted.
sources.design_inference: Keep the intended keyboard stick mode consistent; mixing virtual-controller and keyboard modes is a separate compatibility decision.

sources.title: Capcom — Resident Evil 6 PC controls
sources.supported_finding: The PC manual lists Space-related movement chords, V plus directional partner commands, Shift plus wheel for sub-weapons and F1–F8 skill choices.
sources.limit: This is an older-game stress reference added to the analysis, not a newly completed full catalogue entry.
sources.design_inference: Key-family labels do not imply urgency; ordinary letters can act as hold modifiers and navigation can be part of combat.

sources.title: Azeron — Software
sources.supported_finding: Manufacturer software documentation describes profile and configuration capabilities.
sources.limit: Native structure is instead grounded in the user-supplied 2.0.2 backup; this page is not runtime validation.
sources.design_inference: Do not claim import or hardware success from JSON generation.

sources.title: Sega — Bayonetta PC on Steam
sources.supported_finding: Bayonetta is a separate PC release published by Sega.
sources.limit: The linked PC manual could not be read in this pass; no complete effective key table is established.
sources.design_inference: Do not copy Bayonetta 2/3 or controller labels into the PC key map.

rejected_evidence: All generated game posters from the immediately preceding response: not derived from native mappings or verified keys.
Unattributed online claims about reaction-time improvements or most players without data.
Legacy profiles not tagged layered 1 or FOR CHAT as evidence of the user’s preferences.
